select
from opt_async_task where retry_no <= #{retryNo} and next_retry_time <= NOW() and exec_status in ('unexecuted','abnormal')
select id from opt_async_task where retry_no <= #{retryNo} and next_retry_time <= NOW() and exec_status in ('unexecuted','abnormal') and biz_org_code is null order by next_retry_time limit 50
select from opt_async_task where id = #{id} and retry_no <= #{retryNo} and next_retry_time <= NOW() and exec_status in ('unexecuted','abnormal')
mapper.delete: delete from opt_async_task where type = #{taskType} and biz_id = #{bizId} and exec_status in ('unexecuted','abnormal')
mapper.select: select from opt_async_task where biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and type in ('zkSaveWholesaleReturn','zkSaveWholesaleShipment') and remark is null
mapper.update: update opt_async_task set remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and remark is null

update.foreach: update opt_async_task set retry_no = 1 , next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE),return_result = null,exception_message = null where id = #{item} and type = #{type} and exec_status <> 'success'
